additional_info.subject: RE: 0400553 - ID0400553- DC/Si-D/CL-[Multiple] unstable internet connection CRM:00440000284
additional_info.body:
Hello Jesus,
Please check if you can order the PO if that´s not possible, I can ask my Finances department if they can help.
Currently I can´t see any of the Chargers online. The approach to connect just the SCB Routers is in my eyes a good one.
If you install the FW-Versions the Router keeps the settings that it is forced to LAN. So no need to change here something.
Please keep in mind, that we always need to go to every Major FW-layer which means FW 2.x.x → 3.x.x → 4.x.x → 5.x.x → 6.x.x.
If that is not possible remotely I would suggest that you prepare USB updates and do them Local. Also here please follow the steps with the Major layers.
Could you ping me in Teams as soon as the Chargers are online, then I can have a look at the Interruptions.
With kind regards,
